Name: Magic Apothecary Krobus - English Translation
Author: MaryOliver28
Description:
This mod adds new dialogue for Krobus, and now he is a potion maker! He will give you some gifts (including potions) and will be very friendly with you!


Requires content patcher.


Original mod by luoli1119, go and endorse her mod, it makes tthe autor happy :)

The link to the original Chinese mod is here: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10791

This is my second translation, and since I don't speak Chinese, google translator helped me A LOT, so please tell me with there is any mistakes in my translation (I am also not a english native speaker, but I did my best).

Thank you for your time :)
